name: Bishoujo wa Check ga Osuki
original_name: 美少女はチェックがお好き
source:
You participate in personality quizzes with several girls giving Yes or No answers. If you appear to be the personality the girl likes - she will be undressing with each new round.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你参加性格测验，几个女孩给出“是”或“否”的答案。如果你看起来是女孩喜欢的个性——她会在每一轮新的回合中脱掉衣服。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
